metadata.display_name: Retrieve Batch Of Price Book Items (Price Book Items Crm Reads Api)
metadata.description: Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values.
metadata.learn_more: Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for fetching multiple objects in a single request, allowing for efficient data retrieval. You can specify whether to include archived objects in the results.

objectType.label: Object Type
objectType.description: The type of CRM object to read in batch, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived. Defaults to false.

idProperty.label: Id Property
idProperty.description: A string representing the name of a property whose values are unique for this object type. This property is used to identify objects uniquely.

inputs.label: Inputs
inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each containing an 'id' field that specifies the internal ID of an object to be read.

properties.label: Properties
properties.description: An array of strings representing the properties to be returned for each object. If a specified property is not present on the requested object(s), it will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.label: Properties With History
propertiesWithHistory.description: An array of strings representing the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If a specified property is not present on the requested object(s), it will be ignored.
